ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% low-intensity (black) pixels to 15% high-intensity (white) pixels, with high-intensity pixels localized to trailing edge fringes and discrete surface marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blobs are localized along the superior trailing edges of both lobes; the central and inferior regions are a solid low-intensity dark field punctuated by discrete white circular and linear clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an acute angle and deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration with variable pixel-amplitude peaks; prominent jagged indentations visible on the left lobe superior margin and finer serrations on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in thickened, irregular outer margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of high-contrast white circular rings (rosettes) distributed across the dark ventral surface; high-density, three-dimensional calcified clusters (barnacles) are localized on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions; includes a prominent long horizontal mark on the left lobe and several shorter, unaligned diagonal marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal lateral edges and numerous circular and linear scars across the primary fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced cluster of protruding barnacle shells on the outer-most edges of both the left and right fluke tips, creating a highly irregular, non-linear boundary.
